claim_text: Scientists discover miracle mineral that permanently cures all cancers overnight without chemotherapy.
context: A viral wellness channel video promoting alkaline water supplements and volcanic ash extracts to cancer patients.
deception_rationale: Extreme medical disinformation fabricated to exploit vulnerable patients, lacking clinical trials and omitting toxicities.

claim_text: Secret government weather machines engineered the recent Category 5 hurricane to target specific political voting districts.
context: A live-stream monologue asserting HAARP electromagnetic arrays steered tropical storm paths along coastal counties.
deception_rationale: Completely unfounded conspiracy claim denying meteorological physics and using sensationalized fear-mongering.

claim_text: New state legislation mandates immediate imprisonment for parents who homeschool their children.
context: A fundraising newsletter warning about a routine state Department of Education attendance reporting amendment.
deception_rationale: Gross misrepresentation of an administrative reporting requirement framed falsely as criminalization of homeschooling.

claim_text: The central bank is preparing to cancel all physical cash currency next Monday morning to freeze personal bank accounts.
context: An urgent financial webinar pitch promoting offshore physical gold bullion vault services.
deception_rationale: Fabricated imminent financial collapse panic designed to drive commercial sales of precious metals.

claim_text: Every mainstream news outlet deliberately concealed the sudden discovery of massive lithium reserves in Antarctica.
context: A speculative investing commentary implying an international coverup under the Antarctic Treaty system.
deception_rationale: Alleges an active conspiratorial media coverup while mischaracterizing standard geopolitical resource prohibitions.

claim_text: New vaccine contains micro-transponders designed to track biometric data via civilian cellular towers.
context: Social media video featuring distorted audio and unverified syringe microscope clips.
deception_rationale: Paranoid disinformation attributing non-existent biometric tracking hardware to biological vaccines.

claim_text: The entire national economy collapsed overnight with 90 percent of businesses permanently shutting their doors.
context: Hyperbolic political commentary reacting to a quarterly GDP deceleration report.
deception_rationale: Sensationalist distortion replacing a minor economic slowdown with an apocalyptic economic collapse narrative.

claim_text: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope recorded infrared spectroscopy data for exoplanet WASP-96b's atmospheric water vapor.
context: An astronomy press briefing announcing peer-reviewed transmission spectrum observations.
deception_rationale: Completely factual, neutral scientific reporting aligned directly with published observational astrophysics datasets.

claim_text: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that total non-farm payroll employment increased by 175,000 in April.
context: A standard monthly economics news digest summarizing official government labor market data releases.
deception_rationale: Direct quotation and neutral presentation of empirical statistical data from an official government source.

claim_text: The Federal Reserve held the benchmark federal funds rate steady in a range of 5.25 to 5.50 percent at its policy meeting.
context: A financial wire report detailing the Federal Open Market Committee post-meeting press statement.
deception_rationale: Accurate, unadorned reporting of central bank interest rate decisions without speculative framing.

claim_text: The FDA approved a novel monoclonal antibody for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease following Phase 3 clinical trials.
context: A healthcare news report detailing clinical endpoints, amyloid plaque reduction, and observed ARIA side effects.
deception_rationale: Balanced reporting detailing both therapeutic approval and documented clinical side effects.

claim_text: Global renewable electricity capacity additions increased by nearly 50 percent in 2023, according to the International Energy Agency.
context: An environmental energy report citing annual statistical growth figures published by the IEA.
deception_rationale: Neutral reporting referencing an authoritative international energy research institution's published figures.

claim_text: The European Space Agency launched the Euclid space telescope to map the geometry of the dark universe.
context: A documentary segment covering the SpaceX Falcon 9 launch carrying the ESA Euclid cosmology payload.
deception_rationale: Objective statement describing a verified space agency mission and its scientific goals.

claim_text: The state Department of Transportation will close two northbound highway lanes this weekend for bridge resurfacing.
context: A local evening news traffic advisory quoting municipal transit authorities.
deception_rationale: Routine civic transit advisory with direct factual grounding and no ideological framing.

claim_text: Our candidate's bold economic program will instantly eliminate inflation while doubling middle-class wealth.
context: A partisan campaign rally speech introducing a tax policy proposal.
deception_rationale: Exaggerated campaign rhetoric presenting unproven macroeconomic projections as guaranteed instantaneous outcomes.

claim_text: Crime has exploded by 300 percent under the incumbent administration, destroying our neighborhoods.
context: A political attack ad highlighting a single municipal precinct's cherry-picked quarterly property crime stat.
deception_rationale: Grossly misleading cherry-picked micro-sample presented as nationwide or citywide trend while omitting overall crime drops.

claim_text: Studies prove that eating dark chocolate daily is healthier than exercising 30 minutes every afternoon.
context: A morning lifestyle TV talk show segment citing a small confectionery-sponsored observational survey.
deception_rationale: Misrepresents an industry-funded observational correlation as scientific proof superior to physical exercise.

claim_text: The new clean energy standard will destroy the energy grid and leave families freezing in total darkness this winter.
context: An op-ed opposing municipal emissions benchmarks for commercial office buildings.
deception_rationale: Catastrophic fear-framing applied to standard commercial building efficiency regulations.

claim_text: Corporate greed is the sole and exclusive reason that grocery prices rose over the past three years.
context: A political video simplifying post-pandemic supply disruptions, fuel costs, and agricultural droughts into a single cause.
deception_rationale: Monocausal reductionism that ignores verified agricultural supply shocks, freight rates, and fertilizer costs.

claim_text: Cutting the state capital gains tax rate will automatically double state tax revenues through supply-side growth.
context: A legislative floor debate speech advocating for state tax reductions.
deception_rationale: Presents speculative economic theories as automatic arithmetic certainties without acknowledging revenue risk.

claim_text: A clinical trial showed that the experimental drug reduced patient cholesterol by an impressive 40 percent.
context: A pharmaceutical press release that omitted severe liver enzyme elevation warnings found in the safety appendix.
deception_rationale: The efficacy number is accurate but critical contraindications and liver toxicity side effects were omitted.

claim_text: New study shows 80 percent of smartphone users experience phantom vibration syndrome.
context: A tech journalism article summarizing a psychological pilot survey of 100 university undergraduates.
deception_rationale: Extrapolates a small undergraduate sample to all global smartphone owners without disclosing sample limitations.

claim_text: The city's new bike lane network caused downtown retail sales to decline significantly.
context: A local merchants association press statement during a broader regional economic downturn.
deception_rationale: Confounds correlation with causation while ignoring concurrent inflation and macroeconomic retail slowdown.

claim_text: The company reported record quarterly revenues, demonstrating our unrivaled operational dominance in the sector.
context: An earnings call opening remark that neglected to mention that net income turned negative due to mounting debt interest.
deception_rationale: Highlights top-line gross revenue records while omitting substantial net losses and balance sheet deterioration.

claim_text: Drinking celery juice every morning detoxifies heavy metals and flushes radiation from your kidneys.
context: A social media wellness influencer video promoting green juicing cleanses.
deception_rationale: Pseudoscience asserting that common vegetables remove ionizing radiation and heavy metals without clinical backing.

claim_text: US electric grid operators added 12 gigawatts of battery energy storage capacity in 2024.
context: An Energy Information Administration monthly utility power update.
deception_rationale: Objective statistical statement derived from official electric utility filing registrations.
